correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md fixes strict named-colour preference profiles, proper colourings, envy arcs, stability as directed acyclicity and the all-profiles minimum. For k=chi_stable(G)>=2, the upper bound assigns the apex its top-ranked colour and uses an arbitrary stable k-colouring on the other colours; no envy edge leaves the apex. For the lower bound, take an actual (k-1)-palette obstruction, put new colour k last at every original vertex and first at the apex. If apex uses k the obstructed profile remains; if apex uses c<k and any original uses k, their edge is an envy 2-cycle; otherwise all originals use colours from the obstructed (k-1)-palette, impossible. For k=1 nonempty G is edgeless, apex forces at least two colours. Iterate t and include t=0. The finite P4 blocked-preference witness was independently enumerated using adjacency/DFS rather than relying on repository VERIFY_OK. No finite enumeration is treated as an all-graph proof.
